title: Reuters: Citadel buys most of Situational’s stock holdings after AI share rout, sources say
content:
REUTERS reports:
Situational Awareness, an AI-focused ​hedge fund run by former OpenAI researcher Leopold Aschenbrenner, sold the bulk of its stock portfolio to Ken Griffin’s Citadel after being battered ‌by heavy losses in its tech holdings, two sources familiar with the matter told Reuters (…).
